newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA RAILWAY OPENS ELECTRIC LINK TO YUGOSLAVIA.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA RAILWAY OPENS ELECTRIC LINK TO YUGOSLAVIA.

text.p: The Bulgarian State Railway (BSR) will start operating its newly electrified link from Sofia to the Yugoslav border this week, state radio said on Wednesday.
BSR director general Anguel Dimitrov said a 34-km link from Sofia to the Dragoman checkpoint on the Serbian border will start operating on Friday.
The electrified link, which cost 350 million levs, will halve the travelling time, Dimitrov told reporters while travelling from Sofia to the border.
Dimitrov has said the railway has been seeking funds for the electrification of a 150-km link from the town of Dimitrovgrad to the Kapitan Andreevo checkpoint on the Turkish border.
